messages:
maya: Heads up — Atlas Analytics just asked for a per-route throughput QoS add-on that guarantees 2x reserved capacity and a per-route SLA. They want contract language by EOW. Thoughts? cc @jonathan @li

jonathan: We can do reserved lanes but per-route guarantees change autoscaler/placement. Need infra impact and ops cost estimates. @sara can you weigh in on complexity?

sara: For Dedicated customers we can carve pools, but isolating by route (vs by customer) adds routing metadata and slows autoscale. Ops overhead ~1.5-2 FTE to maintain if manual overrides are needed. :thinking_face:

li: From pricing: suggest 3 add-on tiers to keep it simple — "isolation-lite" (best-effort soft guarantees), "isolation-plus" (SLA-backed with burst credits), "isolation-dedicated" (hard resource isolation + 99.9% per-route SLA). Need legal on SLA language; also need to map to per-GPU or per-RPS pricing.

tim_sales: Sales wants one clean line item: "Per-route QoS add-on" with capacity bands. Customer expects scaling during launches — can't be strictly hard cap-only. A pilot option would help close.

legal_qa: Draft clause starter: `Redwood will use commercially reasonable efforts to maintain per-route availability of 99.9% when the Isolation-Plus or Isolation-Dedicated add-on is purchased. In the event of a breach, Customer's sole and exclusive remedy shall be service credits up to a cap of X% of Monthly Fees.` We should avoid absolute hardware guarantees and include substitution/failover language.

maya: Action items: 1) Eng feasibility note (perf + cost estimate) by Tue EOD. 2) Pricing to map tiers + per-unit rates. 3) Legal to produce two clause options (soft SLA vs hard SLA with credits). 4) Sales one-pager for Atlas with pilot path. @jonathan take eng. @li pricing. @legal_qa legal. @tim_sales one-pager.

jonathan: I'll run sims: shared pool w/ per-route shaping vs isolated pools. Will include autoscaler ops burden, expected tail latency delta, and rough cost delta for reserved GPUs. ETA Tue EOD.

li: I'll sketch pricing and margin model. Tentative placeholder: isolation-lite $2k/mo, isolation-plus $8k/mo + $0.04 per guaranteed token, isolation-dedicated custom enterprise pricing. Will refine after eng inputs.

legal_qa: I'll prepare two clause drafts + fallback paragraph for force majeure and hardware substitution. If customer insists on hard uptime numbers we should include narrow remedies only.

tim_sales: I'll draft a 1-pager and a pilot proposal: 30-day Isolation-Plus pilot (telemetry + rollback). That gives Atlas a runway to validate.

maya: Pilot path approved in principle. If eng says infeasible we'll pivot to offering burst credits + monitoring + an ops playbook instead. Thanks y'all :rocket:

ops_bot: Asana task created — PRIC-2146 "Per-route QoS addon feasibility" assigned to jonathan.
